intro: Logging Rope is heavy cordage vital to the Warsong clan's ongoing logging operations within Ashenvale. Shipments of this sturdy line were ambushed and stolen by local furbolg tribes who violently resist the Horde's expansion into the ancient forest.

p: Maintaining the goblin-built machinery and lumber mills of the Warsong Lumber Camp requires massive quantities of durable logging line. Rather than reaching the loggers at their encampment, essential shipments were intercepted by the Foulweald and Thistlefur furbolg tribes. Driven mad by corruption and fiercely defensive of their ancestral woods, these furbolgs hoard the stolen ropes in their encampments across northern and central Ashenvale.

Locke Okarr at Splintertree Post is tasked with recovering the misplaced logistical chain before the Warsong lumber camp grinds to a halt. Reclaiming the heavy rope directly from the furbolg den-mothers and warriors allows the Horde to secure fellable timber, bound logs, and rig saw machinery amidst constant guerrilla resistance from the native forest inhabitants.
